point: This PR makes the Turso client's execute() retry up to 4 times with jittered backoff on 503 and 429, which fixes cold-start boot failures that a 2026-09-14 refactor introduced, and the author measured it and added tests.

stumbles.why: The change allows up to 4 retries, which is 5 attempts. Four 503s followed by a 200 would succeed, so this case contradicts the retry limit unless the server keeps returning 503. The text doesn't say which.
